notes: Account snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation for SMBs in EU). Heavy chat and search features in product.
Initial interest: quick integration via hosted API to unblock product rollout; later move to Dedicated for predictable latency/cost.

Main technical asks: EU-only data residency for EU customers, cross-region routing options for NA users, ability to pin model versions, support for prefix caching and KV cache during stateful chat sessions.
Latency targets: 120-200ms token-latency target for interactive chat at 20-50 concurrent users; throughput target ~50 req/s during spikes.
Cost sensitivity: unit cost per token must be competitive; finance wants 12-month committed pricing scenario for Dedicated with burst capacity behavior documented.
POC plan: 2-week hosted API smoke run (baseline), followed by 3-week Dedicated beta in eu-west with canary routing and fallback to hosted in other regions.
Quote from product lead: 'We can accept slightly higher latency for NA users if EU residency and deterministic latency for EU customers is guaranteed.'
Security: need SSO (SAML), KMS integration for model keys, audit logs retention 12 months, data residency clause in DPA. Legal asked for example network diagrams and cert pages.

Routing concerns: want multi-region routing with policy to route EU users to eu-west Dedicated pool; fallback rules when Dedicated saturated to route to hosted EU variant only (no cross-border to NA).
Technical unknowns: warmup/kv-cache behaviors after autoscaling events, exact Dedicated instance types needed for their mixed chat+rerank workload.
Docs shared: pricing deck + security questionnaire (links above). SE provided sample throughput test harness (runbook) to reproduce latency numbers.
Current sentiment: positive but cautious — product team likes API ergonomics; finance/legal are the gating factors.
Next milestone: finish Dedicated perf run (target complete by 2026-03-24), then pricing term proposal to finance/legal.
